DevLab third-party browser assets

The license texts listed below are in this directory. Links identify the
upstream source versions used by DevLab.

Diagrams

The beautiful-mermaid browser bundle includes the following packages.

beautiful-mermaid 1.1.3 (MIT)
  License: beautiful-mermaid.txt
  Source: https://github.com/lukilabs/beautiful-mermaid/tree/65f4e0ab8c289e9691a9e5bc4f9eac7108cf449b

elkjs 0.11.1 (EPL-2.0)
  License: elkjs.txt
  The elkjs source is available under the Eclipse Public License 2.0.
  Source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/572e73323791d05f09b0815ff639af2b67f202ab
  Eclipse Layout Kernel source linked by the elkjs 0.11.1 release:
  https://github.com/eclipse-elk/elk/tree/c831ba4613dfd6b0055851193956560351d2f907

entities 7.0.1 (BSD-2-Clause)
  License: entities.txt
  Source: https://github.com/fb55/entities/tree/994259f32eba1c822c16da075656f745c493c560

Search

Lunr Languages 1.22.0 (MPL-1.1)
  License: lunr-languages.txt
  The German, Russian and shared stemmer source files are available under
  the Mozilla Public License 1.1 at this exact upstream revision:
  https://github.com/MihaiValentin/lunr-languages/tree/41efd0e54bfd12e7ddee841ef9d80092d6aa7853

ElasticLunr 0.9.6 (MIT), supplied by Zola when search indexing is enabled
  License: elasticlunr.txt
  Copyright (C) 2017 Oliver Nightingale and Wei Song, as credited in the asset.
  Source: https://github.com/weixsong/elasticlunr.js/tree/83b3d3538d0a9295e59806c48786d10a049bddf5
  Asset shipped in Zola 0.23.6:
  https://github.com/getzola/zola/blob/v0.23.6/components/search/src/elasticlunr.min.js
